summary: Initial MVP testing of ZURO ecommerce. Backend 20/20 pytest passed across auth, products, cart, wishlist, orders, admin, coupons. Frontend smoke tested: homepage, shop (8 products), product detail (add-to-cart toast working), admin dashboard (stats correctly displayed), custom builder render. Admin login via UI succeeded.

minor.issue: No server-side total recalculation or stock decrement; client-supplied total trusted.
Uses query params for sensitive payment_id/signature instead of JSON body; not idempotent.
No brute-force lockout despite login_attempts index being created on startup; refresh-token rotation endpoint missing.
Accepts arbitrary status string via query param; no enum validation.

ui_bugs.issue: Navigating to /cart while logged in as admin rendered Profile content (page header shows MY PROFILE). Possible route guard/redirect bug or empty-cart fallback rendering wrong component.
page.query_selector_all('input') returned 0 elements - form may not be mounting input elements with standard tag (could be using custom components or auth gate redirect).
<title> still shows 'Emergent | Fullstack App' instead of ZURO branding.

integration_issues.issue: /api/auth/me 401 errors logged to console on every public page; should be silenced or call gated by token presence.

issues: React warning: 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' - setState during render in a context/provider.

action_items: Fix /cart route showing Profile content for admin user (verify CartPage rendering & auth redirects)
Verify RegisterPage form inputs are accessible/rendered (data-testid recommended)
Update document <title> to ZURO branding in public/index.html
Fix React setState-in-render warning (likely in CartContext/AuthContext)
Add server-side order total recompute + stock decrement in /api/orders/create
Add enum validation for order status updates; move Razorpay verify fields to JSON body
Add data-testid attributes on key elements (login form, cart icon, add-to-cart, size/color buttons) to improve test stability
Silence 401 console noise from /api/auth/me when no session
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 660-line file - split into routers/auth.py, routers/products.py, etc.
Order creation accepts client total - financial integrity risk.
Login lacks rate limiting despite login_attempts index created (dead code).
Razorpay verify uses query params for signature/payment_id - should be POST JSON body.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject - rely on explicit env value.
Storage init_storage() is sync requests inside async startup - acceptable but block event loop.
test_credentials: admin@zuro.com / ZuroAdmin@2024 (verified). Test user created dynamically during tests.
seed_data_creation: 8 products already seeded; tests create transient users/orders prefixed with random uuid.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 20 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend: focus retest on (1) /cart route content for both admin & regular user, (2) register page form interaction with explicit data-testid, (3) checkout COD end-to-end through UI. Admin dashboard, product browsing, add-to-cart, login flow all verified working in this iteration.
